lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular white pixel clusters arranged in 5-7 discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The blobs maintain a semi-regular grid-like distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: The white circular blobs are positioned at the intersections of faint, vertically oriented bands of elevated pixel intensity and the horizontal carinae, creating a structured nodal grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge, running parallel to the longitudinal body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin exhibits a distribution of approximately 12-15 high-luminance white blobs of varying sizes, concentrated primarily in the lower and middle regions of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, high-intensity white linear marker or lesion is visible on the ventral surface posterior to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The anterior head region exhibits a high-density cluster of micro-spots (small, low-diameter high-luminance pixels) that transition into the larger, more widely spaced blobs of the lateral flank.
